headline: Infinity Machine reports mixed human-led and autonomous research outcomes with unresolved reliability gaps
summary: A preprint describes Infinity Machine, a research agent and evaluation system, and reports outputs across quantum information, circuit routing, astronomy and modeled chip design. The paper says 14 campaigns were operator-led, while three fully autonomous runs all ended in ties; an autonomous scorer direction bug went undetected, and a proposed self-improvement result was rejected after a small held-in gain at twice the cost. These are author-reported results from a single-operator study, not evidence of general autonomous discovery or reliable self-improvement.
